data.provenance_text: The artist; purchased by Joseph Durand-Ruel, Paris, December 1897 [according to a letter from Caroline Durand-Ruel Godfroy, Durand-Ruel, to Gloria Groom dated October 23, 1992, in curatorial file; Durand-Ruel stock book no. 4471]; sold to Durand-Ruel, New York, June 12, 1901 [according to the letter cited above; Durand-Ruel stock book no. 2612]; given to the Art Institute, December 13, 1905.
